scope: Exact clean Git export and HACS-shaped custom integration payload for the local-unpublished Hub source catalog; source and payload provenance only

archive.format: git archive tar with one commit-qualified top-level directory
archive.reproducibility: Two consecutive git archive constructions from the immutable commit were byte-identical

complete_manifest.algorithm: Compact sorted-key JSON over every regular Git-export file with path, SHA-256, byte size and exact Git mode; repository, commit and tree are bound at the top level

hub_catalog_source_record.algorithm: Hub tools/companions/core.py source_manifest_for schema; AGENTS.md is the only clean-export file intentionally excluded by the Hub catalog walker

profile.verification: All 17 SHA256SUMS entries passed against the frozen export

component_payload.algorithm: C-locale payload-relative path order; one UTF-8 line '<path> <sha256>\n' per regular file under custom_components/teslatlas_hub
component_payload.source_binding: Generated from the frozen dfb2b050 export and independently compared byte-for-byte with the retained r1 manifest

historical_runtime_receipt.disposition: Preserved as historical runtime evidence only; not rebound to dfb2b050 and not the selection receipt for this current-source catalog handoff

catalog_selection.selection_receipt_sha256_location: Record the SHA-256 of this immutable tracked file after freezing; the receipt does not contain its own digest

safety_and_cleanup.retained_output: Owner-only read-only artifact root listed in source.archive and source.frozen_export

independent_review.source_count_reconciliation: The complete clean Git export contains 102 regular files. The Hub source walker intentionally excludes only AGENTS.md, producing the accepted 101-file catalog source record without omitting runtime, package, profile, test or documentation bytes.
independent_review.catalog_input_limit: Accepted only as an exact local-unpublished current-source and component-payload input. No Hub catalog mutation, installation, runtime, replacement/rollback, publication or F4/F5/F6/F7 acceptance follows from this review.
independent_review.metadata_delta: This review metadata changes the selection-receipt file hash and requires the same reviewer to confirm the metadata-only delta before catalog admission.

limitations: This handoff does not prove manual installation, Container operation, HA OS or Supervisor compatibility, HACS publication, replacement, rollback or removal.
No Home Assistant or Hub runtime was rerun, and the historical f650331 runtime receipt is not current-source runtime acceptance.
F4, F5, F6 and F7 remain open; this receipt is a bounded current-source and catalog-payload input only.
Hub must independently recompute the source and payload records and explicitly admit the selection receipt before using these hashes in its catalog.
